basic_details.job_title: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (ISM) Dhanbad (IIT (ISM) Dhanbad) has announced 1 project-based vacancy for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow post under the recruitment. The appointment is tenure-based, lasting until 2 September 2029 or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier, under advertisement number ANRF/ECRG/2025/002793/PMS and SRDP 1408 G. The position offers a pay of Rs. 37,000 PM + HRA. Eligible candidates must possess an M.Sc. (Physics) with 1st class or min 60% marks / 6.0 CGPA and valid CSIR-UGC NET or GATE qualification. content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Junior Research Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Complexity-Aware Hamiltonian Engineering for Non-Ergodic Quantum Dynamics
Till 02/09/2029 or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier (maximum 3 years or till the end of the project)
Rs. 37,000/- PM + admissible HRA (first two years); Rs. 42,000/- PM + admissible HRA (third year for SRF)
As per ANRF norms (Relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per GOI norms)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential educational qualifications and criteria specified for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position. Essential Qualification: M.Sc. (Physics) with 1st class or min 60% marks / 6.0 CGPA (if class is not awarded) and valid CSIR-UGC NET (including LS) or GATE qualification. Desirable Qualification: Knowledge of quantum mechanics and quantum many-body physics; programming experience (Python/Julia/C++); familiarity with numerical methods for quantum dynamics. Age Limit and Relaxation: Age as per ANRF norms, with relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PH candidates according to Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed as a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) with a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month plus admissible HRA if staying outside the campus for the first two years. Upon upgrading to Senior Research Fellow (SRF) in the third year, the fellowship becomes Rs. 42,000/- per month plus admissible HRA. Upgradation from JRF to SRF and the SRF conditions comply with DST O.M. No. DST/PCPM/Z-06/2022 dated 26.06.2023. The tenure lasts until 02/09/2029 or until the project terminates, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out theoretical and numerical studies of non-ergodic quantum dynamics and Hamiltonian engineering. Develop and run simulation codes on the project's GPU workstation. Analysing the results and preparing reports and manuscripts. Ensure the timely and successful completion of the project work in consultation with the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad ANRF Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare an application quoting project number ANRF/ECRG/2025/002793/PMS. Gather all supporting documents for qualifications, NET/GATE certification, and category proofs. Send the application and supporting documents via email to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Sudipto Singha Roy, at [email protected] . Ensure the application reaches the specified email address on or before 3 November 2026, 6:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the date of the interview. Mere possession of minimum qualification does not guarantee an invitation to the interview. Candidates will be short-listed based on their merit and as per the requirement of the project. Candidates must arrange their own accommodation and travel for their stay at Dhanbad if required, as no TA/DA is paid to attend the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under this recruitment notice?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the ANRF Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 3 November 2026 up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.Sc. in Physics with 1st class or a minimum of 60% marks / 6.0 CGPA, along with a valid CSIR-UGC NET or GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The age limit follows ANRF norms, with relaxations applicable for SC, ST, OBC, and PH candidates according to GOI rules.

faq.question: Q5. What fellowship amount will be paid to the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month plus admissible HRA for the first two years, which upgrades to Rs. 42,000/- per month plus admissible HRA for the third year as an SRF.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their application quoting project number ANRF/ECRG/2025/002793/PMS along with supporting documents via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection involves shortlisting based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent or tenure-based?
faq.answer: The appointment is tenure-based, lasting until 2 September 2029 or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the desirable qualifications for the post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include knowledge of quantum mechanics and quantum many-body physics, programming experience in Python, Julia, or C++, and familiarity with numerical methods for quantum dynamics.
